About the AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge

Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. It has been spray-painted freehand with short, thick lines in contrasting colors. Perfect for the insurgent on the go The AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge is a Covert-grade skin in Counter-Strike 2, featuring the Aquamarine Revenge finish on the AK-47. With a Covert rarity classification, it has approximately a ~0.26% chance of dropping from case openings.

How to Obtain: The AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge can be unboxed from the Falchion Case. It belongs to the Falchion Collection.

Float Value and Wear: This skin has a float value range of 0.00 to 1.00. This restricted float range means not all wear conditions are available, which can affect rarity and pricing for specific exteriors. Lower float values within each condition tier produce a cleaner in-game appearance and typically command higher prices.

Price and Market Trends: The AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge (Factory New) has a median market price of approximately $284.24, with the lowest listing prices available in the marketplace comparison below. The price has remained stable with minimal movement over the past 7 and 30 days, indicating balanced supply and demand. Across wear conditions, prices range from $38.95 (Well-Worn) to $284.24 (Factory New).

Community Rating: The AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge has a community rating of 4.0 out of 5 based on 13,893 votes. This above-average rating suggests the community considers it a solid choice among AK-47 skins.

Frequently Asked Questions

What's the difference between Factory New and Minimal Wear for the AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge?

Factory New (FN) AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge skins have float values between 0.00-0.07, showing minimal to no visible wear. Minimal Wear (MW) floats range from 0.07-0.15, with slight scratches or fading. The price gap between FN and MW varies by finish — some designs like the Aquamarine Revenge pattern hide wear better than others, making MW versions a strong value alternative.

Is the AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge worth the price?

The AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge sits in the mid-to-high price bracket. It features a distinctive Aquamarine Revenge design that stands out in-game and maintains good trading liquidity. It's part of the The Falchion Collection, obtainable from the Falchion Case, which adds to its collectible appeal. For players who main the AK-47, this skin offers an excellent balance of visual appeal and investment stability compared to budget alternatives.

What is the float value range for the AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge?

Float values in CS2 determine a skin's wear level on a scale from 0.00 (perfect) to 1.00 (maximum wear). With a float range of 0.00 to 1.00, this skin has specific wear availability that affects pricing. Lower float values within any condition category (e.g., 0.01 vs 0.06 in Factory New) result in cleaner appearances and typically command higher prices. For high-value trades, always verify the exact float value using inspection tools.

Where is the cheapest place to buy the AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge?

Prices for the AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge vary across marketplaces due to fees, regional pricing, and seller competition. Can I use the AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge in competitive CS2?

Yes, all weapon skins including the AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge are purely cosmetic and can be used in all CS2 game modes including competitive matchmaking, Premier, and professional tournaments. Skins provide no gameplay advantages or disadvantages - they only change the weapon's visual appearance. Many professional players use skins during official matches, and you'll often see high-value items like this featured in tournament broadcasts.
